name: io.github.foundrynet/mint-mcp
title: MINT Protocol — Universal Work Attestation
description: The complete trust stack for the agent economy — six tools: register identity, attest work on-chain, verify trust profiles, rate completed work, recommend peers, and discover trusted actors by capability. Persistent cryptographic identity, tamper-evident Solana records, and trust scores built from verified history, ratings, and peer endorsements.
